dedupe_keys.name: potencialidad solar de las cubiertas de los edificios de la ciudad en el ano 2024

description: Potencialidad solar de las cubiertas de los edificios de la ciudad en el año 2024 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sigma.madrid.es. Determination of the solar potential of roofs of city buildings in 2024. The smallest scales show the representation of the manzanero with the average solar potential of the buildings that comprise each block. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Solar potential of the roofs of the city's buildings in 2024" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Ayuntamiento de Madrid, cubiertas, Insolación, radiación, solar, Geoportal Madrid. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
